description: Header file defining the DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher class responsible for DHCP lookup and PAC file fetching on Windows within Chromium project.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Class managing DHCP lookup and PAC file fetch for a network adapter on Windows.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating DHCP query work on a worker thread.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Starts DHCP lookup and PAC file fetch process.

methods.name: DidFinish
methods.description: Checks if fetch process has completed successfully.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns network error code of fetch operation.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves PAC URL from DHCP for a given adapter.
